newsitem.title: BELGIUM: France, auction weigh but OLO support expected.
newsitem.headline: France, auction weigh but OLO support expected.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds were weak, in line with Bunds, in cautious pre-auction trade on Monday as speculation mounted of a snap election in France.
But traders said OLOs still appeared well supported and would trim their losses after the auction at which the existing March 2007 OLOs and new January 2000 OLOs are up for sale.
At 0800 GMT, the 2007 OLO was yielding 5.98 percent against 5.93 percent at the close on Friday.
"After the auction, players will probably buy back Belgium a bit. The market looks pretty well supported," one trader said.
Traders said they saw little interest by institutional investors in the auction of the 2007 OLO. "But perhaps banks' portfolios could still be put in," one said.
The OLO/Bund yield spread, which had widened to 13 basis points late last week on OAT/Bund yield spread widening and new supply from the auction, was further up at 14 basis points.
But traders said it was bound to narrow again after the auction and once a final decision was known on whether French elections would be held or not.
